source: Literal comparison of the frozen model patch files, before cycle7 simulation.

new_v04_entries.rationale: The CarveMe universal gram-negative biomass demands menaquinol (mql8), but P. putida KT2440 has no menaquinone biosynthesis genes (no menF, menD, menH, menB, menC, menE; only the bifunctional ubiE/menG methyltransferase annotation) and uses ubiquinone; to satisfy the demand the reference gap-fill had invented a route to the naphthoquinone ring through oxalyl-CoA decarboxylase and a phenylpyruvate oxidation (OXCDC, PHPYROX), which with the demand removed are no longer needed.
new_v04_entries.flagged_by: reference gap-fill: OXCDC and PHPYROX were each necessary only for mql8_c (biomass precursor test); genome-wide feature table: no men genes

new_v04_entries.rationale: gene-less gap-fill reaction made unnecessary by the biomass correction above

S. meliloti 1021 is a ubiquinone organism with no menaquinone pathway in the genome (the only hit is the bifunctional ubiE methyltransferase); the draft satisfies the template's menaquinol demand through the last step alone (AMMQLT8) from a 2-demethylmenaquinol it has no way to make properly.
new_v04_entries.flagged_by: biomass-template review after the P. putida case; genome-wide feature table

new_v04_entries.name: Acetylornithine deacetylase
new_v04_entries.rationale: The draft has every arginine-pathway step except the one that releases ornithine from N-acetylornithine (no ACODA, no ORNTAC), so the reference gap-fill made ornithine by running an ornithine cyclodeaminase backwards from proline (ORNCD). SO3749 (SO_RS17460, 'N-acetyl-ornithine deacetylase', argE) is the annotated enzyme.
new_v04_entries.flagged_by: reference gap-fill: ORNCD was necessary only for arg__L_c; genome annotation argE

new_v04_entries.name: L-Lactate dehydrogenase (ubiquinone)
new_v04_entries.rationale: S. oneidensis oxidises L-lactate with the membrane-associated, quinone-linked LldEFG complex (SO_1518 LutC/YkgG family, SO_1519 lactate utilization protein B, SO_1520 Fe-S-binding protein; the L-lactate permease SO_1522 is next to them), not with an NAD-dependent dehydrogenase; the reference gap-fill had added the NAD-dependent LDH_L without a gene. The quinone-linked form is the annotated one and, for an aerobe, the physiologically right one.
new_v04_entries.flagged_by: reference gap-fill: LDH_L was the gene-less fill for the lactate reference condition; the fitness data on lactate can now score SO1518-SO1520

new_v04_entries.name: Zinc (Zn+2) transport via diffusion (extracellular to periplasm)
new_v04_entries.rationale: outer-membrane diffusion of zinc, gene-less (rule R5); needed for ZNabcpp below

new_v04_entries.name: Zinc (Zn+2) transport via ABC system (periplasm)
new_v04_entries.rationale: The draft has no zinc uptake system (only a citrate-coupled zinc reaction, CITt15, and an exporter), so the reference gap-fill took zinc in through a citrate/acetate antiport (CITACt); the genome carries the znuABC-type ABC transporter (SO_0565 Zn/Mn-family substrate-binding protein, SO_0566 permease, SO_4820 'zinc ABC transporter' ATP-binding).
new_v04_entries.flagged_by: reference gap-fill: CITACt was necessary only for zn2_c

new_v04_entries.rationale: gene-less gap-fill replaced by the zinc ABC transporter

expected_scope.Btheta: No model-patch difference; gene/condition predictions should be unchanged.
expected_scope.Putida: Remove biomass menaquinol demand and OXCDC/PHPYROX gap-fill reactions.
expected_scope.MR1: Replace ORNCD, LDH_L and CITACt gap-fills with annotated ACODA, L_LACD2 and zinc ABC uptake.

interpretation: These are the earlier author's patch rationales, not independently confirmed biological conclusions.
